candidate.source: One standard 52-card deck, no jokers. Deal evenly for 3–6 players by setting aside enough twos. A regular bid starts at half the hand rounded up and must top the previous bid. Call Amerikaner to take all tricks alone. On a regular bid, lead to set trump and request a partner card. Follow suit when able. The team each gains or loses the bid; other players gain their trick counts. Highest score wins once a score reaches 52.
